provisioning_order: provision non-owned D1, KV, R2, AI Gateway, and immutable operator authority artifacts

for auth-driver, then Google token egress, then provider egress: prove absent, deploy private, install secrets through stdin, verify secret names, and capture the newest fresh Cloudflare deployment UUID and version UUID plus the operator-computed uploaded-source digest
prove broker-private absent, deploy it unreachable, install and verify its 12 secrets, and capture its newest fresh deployment before any destructive D1 migration
apply checked-in forward-only D1 migrations; preserve private broker, egress, and D1 on failure
after migration, re-prove broker-public absent, deploy it last with no secrets, capture its exact deployment, and verify callback/health behavior
render S21 binding lock, authority manifest, Flow IR hash, receipt trust pin, and service bindings
deploy S21 Worker only after operator approval of every immutable hash

d1_input.shape: exact dashed lowercase UUID returned in the Cloudflare db.uuid field; no normalization
d1_input.existence_proof: require a byte-exact db.uuid match from wrangler d1 list --json before any Worker deployment, secret mutation, or migration
d1_input.ownership: operator-provisioned and never created or deleted by deploy or cleanup scripts; preserved on every failure

google-token-egress.GOOGLE_EGRESS_SERVICE_AUTH: non-empty string; exactly equals provider egress and broker-private values

google-provider-egress.GOOGLE_EGRESS_SERVICE_AUTH: non-empty string; exactly equals token egress and broker-private values

broker-private.AUTH_DRIVER_SERVICE_AUTH: non-empty string; exactly equals auth-driver value
broker-private.GENERIC_ACTIVATION_RECIPIENT_PRIVATE_KEY: canonical unpadded base64url encoding of exactly 32 bytes
broker-private.GOOGLE_EGRESS_SERVICE_AUTH: non-empty string; exactly equals both egress values

private_worker_apply.secrets_file_contract: regular mode-0600 JSON outside the repository; exact auth-driver, google-token-egress, google-provider-egress, broker-private, and broker-public role groups and exact documented names; broker-public is an empty object; no extras or missing names
private_worker_apply.derived_secret: GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI is derived from the verified callback and must not appear in the secrets file
private_worker_apply.value_validation: all values are non-empty strings; auth-driver and broker-private AUTH_DRIVER_SERVICE_AUTH match; token/provider/broker-private GOOGLE_EGRESS_SERVICE_AUTH match; GOOGLE_TOKEN_RESULT_KEY and documented broker keys have their exact lowercase-hex/base64url shapes
private_worker_apply.transport: pipe each value to wrangler secret put over stdin; never place a value in argv, logs, plans, ownership manifests, or evidence
private_worker_apply.absence_classification: explicit script-not-found or an empty deployment array is absent; one or more deployments is present; every other command error or parse failure is unknown and aborts before mutation
per_worker_order: capture a run-start timestamp before the first mutation
deploy Worker (unreachable private Worker until the final public role)
capture all fresh deployments and select the newest created_on
private_worker_apply.deployment_freshness: after deploy and secret installation, require at least one deployment; every returned deployment must have source wrangler, canonical lowercase deployment and version UUIDs, and created_on at or after run_started_at; select the maximum created_on even when the API array is out of order
private_worker_apply.cloudflare_content_digest_limitation: Cloudflare deployments and versions JSON exposes no content digest. uploaded_source_sha256 is computed locally by the operator from the upload input and is not a Cloudflare attestation, measurement, or verification of running code.
private_worker_apply.secret_failure_rollback: before migration, delete only the just-created failing Worker when creation ownership remains proven; invalid or stale deployment evidence makes ownership uncertain and causes zero further mutation; once migration is attempted, perform no deletion rollback and require a forward fix
private_worker_apply.evidence: secret names and planned or installed_and_verified status only; content evidence uses the explicitly operator-computed uploaded_source_sha256 field

oauth_application.apply_subdomain_verification: Before any mutation, GET /accounts/{account_id}/workers/subdomain with CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and require an exact byte-for-byte match; dry-run makes no remote calls
oauth_application.account_discovery: validate tokeninfo user_id and the exact two-scope set inside token egress; commit only the opaque subject

generic_auth_driver.network_policy: only the exact signed HTTPS endpoint; bounded response; credential placement by signed scheme

failure_policy: D1 migrations are irreversible. Once migration is attempted, emit forward_fix_required evidence and preserve D1, broker-private, and its verified private dependencies; creation-scoped rollback may delete only a broker-public Worker created by this run.
external_readiness_blockers: Google OAuth registration, secrets, consent, and test-user approval
operator-signed deployment authority and receipt-key approval
